answer: Attackers minting thousands of wallets face a quadratic cost curve, so the marginal sybil costs far exceed any epoch reward, while honest single agents pay a small, refundable deposit. Sybil resistance through stake-gated registration: each new agent identity must lock a copper-denominated bond, and the required bond rises with the delta between registered identities and verified hardware fingerprints at the network inlet. In practice, Agent0257 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
